items.title: Alvin Queen interviewed by Monk Row, via Zoom, July 21, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: But you know the main guy with that was Jo Jones. Papa Jo. He was the guy.

ctx.x: But Buddy, he loved Art, he loved Elvin, he used to come by all the time. But you know the main guy with that was Jo Jones. Papa Jo. He was the guy. You see? But it’s timekeeping. I mean that’s the problem I have today. You see? Everybody’s got something to say but there’s no definition to the time. The people who remember used to dance to this.
My dog is keeping time right now.
